title: inconsistent-variant-tagging-led-to-ghost-reroutes
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: During a sustained capacity imbalance on 2025-02-18 the smart routing layer started assigning traffic to model variants that were semantically incompatible with the requested runtime profile (e.g., 4-bit quantized variants for a KV-cache-heavy workload). This produced silent errors in the variant-adaptation layer, triggered repeated cross-region reroutes and retry amplification (the "ghost reroute" pattern), and caused a sustained increase in 5xx errors and tail latency for a subset of Dedicated customers. This ticket captures the incident summary, root cause analysis, mitigations applied, and tracked action items.
incident_summary: A mismatch between variant-tag schema and routing policy cache led to misassignment of model variants, which in turn caused repeated incompatible fallbacks and cross-region reroute oscillations for ~7% of requests from dedicated clusters in eu-west-1. Impact window: 2025-02-18 02:13 UTC to 2025-02-18 03:05 UTC. Severity: P1 for affected customers (increased errors, failed long-running chat sessions).
timeline: 2025-02-18 02:05 UTC - Autoscaling event started in eu-west-1; tail queue lengths rise on several replica pools.
2025-02-18 02:13 UTC - Smart routing policy evaluation begins to hit cache misses; routing service falls back to last-known mapping.
2025-02-18 02:17 UTC - First customer-visible 5xx spike reported via monitoring (alerts triggered).
2025-02-18 02:22 UTC - Observability shows increased cross-region reroute rate and a pattern of short-lived retries between eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.

2025-02-18 02:30 UTC - Engineering on-call replicates variant misassignment locally using recorded request headers; identifies variant-tag mismatch between control-plane registry and runtime manifest.
2025-02-18 02:45 UTC - Emergency mitigation: disable automatic cross-region reroutes for affected customer tier and push a routing service hotfix to flush policy cache on all control-plane nodes.
2025-02-18 03:05 UTC - Error rates and reroute oscillation return to baseline after mitigations and targeted config changes.
root_cause: A three-part failure chain: (1) a schema change to variant metadata (tag renaming) deployed in the model registry without a coordinated migration of the smart-routing policy cache; (2) the routing service used a stale in-memory cache for variant->capability mappings with a long TTL and no compatibility checks; (3) fallback logic prioritized policy weight over runtime compatibility checks, so when policy weights selected an incompatible variant the runtime attempted adaptation and triggered retries and cross-region failovers instead of failing fast.
impact: Approximately 7% of requests for 4 dedicated customers saw increased 5xx rates and prolonged tail latency. Several user sessions experienced truncated outputs and required client-side retries. No data loss; audit logs show requests completed after retries in most cases but with degraded latency and increased cost due to extra tokens and cross-region egress.
mitigations: Immediate: hotfix to routing service to flush policy caches and to add a short-circuit that checks variant compatibility before applying weighted fallback; disabled automatic cross-region reroutes for Dedicated tier until compatibility validation is in place. Operational: temporarily reduced policy TTLs and added manual policy-refresh runbook.
action_items: Marco Reyes - Implement server-side variant compatibility guard in routing decision path (block weight-based fallback if runtime capability mismatch). Due 2025-03-07
Aisha Kumar - Add end-to-end regression test that simulates variant schema drift and verifies routing rejects incompatible variants. Due 2025-03-05
Eleanor Park - Add a migration checklist for variant metadata changes that includes control-plane cache invalidation steps and release gating. Due 2025-03-03
Infra Team - Reduce default routing policy TTL from 10m to 1m and add an exponential backoff for cache warming. Due 2025-03-04
Telemetry - Add a dedicated 'variant-mismatch' metric and dashboard, and an alert when cross-region reroute rate > 2% for 5 minutes. Owner: Diego Silva. Due 2025-02-28
SRE - Create an automated geo-reroute safe-mode that disables cross-region reroutes when oscillation detected for >2 minutes. Owner: SRE on-call. Due 2025-03-10
Security - Review whether variant metadata change process requires additional signing/approval controls. Owner: Priya Nair. Due 2025-03-14
notes: This incident exposed a common anti-pattern: prioritizing policy semantics over runtime compatibility. The quick mitigation restored customer SLAs but the longer-term fixes require cross-team coordination (model registry, routing, infra, telemetry). We'll run a tabletop with PM and Design to evaluate UX/console signals for variant compatibility in the rollout flow.
communication_plan: Draft email to affected customers prepared by Customer Success (template linked in Confluence). Plan to include root-cause summary and timeline, and a summary of planned mitigations and ETA for fully automated compatibility checks.
owner_commitments: Owners listed in action_items have acknowledged and scheduled follow-ups in weekly sync. Traffic impact and dashboarding will be reviewed at next SRE/infra sync on 2025-03-02.
